turns.assessment: All degraded services converge on the S04–S14 lightpath, while services that stop at S04 or use the reverse S14–S04 direction remain healthy. The only correlated physical-layer change is increased pre-FEC BER at the S14 receiver trx.och75.z; the absence of corresponding power, OSNR, DGD, or polarization changes strongly favors receiver-local degradation over a line-system fault.

proposals.rationale: A degraded receiver produces errors locally without changing the optical path or other channels. This matches the BER increase at the S14 endpoint and the degradation of all services carried over that terminating lightpath.
A channel-specific passband shift upstream could reduce signal quality while leaving received power approximately unchanged, but there is no direct filter or upstream optical indication.
Reduced channel margin can raise pre-FEC BER, but this mode normally presents as a slow decline rather than the observed onset around t=540 s.
proposals.note: the element's equipment does not document the mode
